node.doctext:
A preliminary attempt to look at the source code of the module foundered

It's [http://cpansearch.perl.org/src/RJBS/Email-Sender-1.300031/lib/Email/Sender/Transport/Print.pm|here], the bit of code that is relevant here is "has 'fh' => ( isa => InstanceOf['IO::Handle'], ..." (and yes, this is from [mod://Moo]).

To put [1nickt]'s [id://1201354|suggestion] into code - if you modify your code like the following, it works for me:

use IO::Handle; my $sm = IO::Handle->new; open ($sm, ...
